summary.whatChanges: In the jsdom environment's Blob compatibility helper, the internal buffer is now read from `_bytes` with a fallback to `_buffer`, matching jsdom 28's renamed internal field. A test asserts a Blob used as a Request body preserves its contents.
behaviorChanges: Blobs passed through the jsdom compat layer (e.g. as a Request body or FormData entry) retain their bytes under jsdom 28 instead of producing empty/undefined content
Existing jsdom versions exposing `_buffer` continue to work via fallback
risks: Relies on jsdom private internals (`implSymbol`, `_bytes`/`_buffer`); a future rename breaks it again
If `_bytes` exists but has a different type/shape than `_buffer`, the constructed Node Blob could hold incorrect data
No guard when both fields are undefined — would pass `undefined` into the Blob constructor
